Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class SellerService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.SellerService
public final class SellerService extends Object
Seller-only actions on the seller's own listings. Every method checks that seller is an active Seller account that owns the listing, and throws SecurityException otherwise, before changing anything.

  • Method Details

    • createListing

      public Listing createListing(User actor, ListingFormState state, PhotoStorage photos)
      Creates a listing from the reusable form for an active Seller, notifying every admin.
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if actor is not a signed-in, active Seller
      IllegalArgumentException - if the form state still has validation errors

    • updateListing

      public Listing updateListing(User actor, Listing listing, ListingFormState state, PhotoStorage photos)
      Applies an edited listing form to one of the seller's own listings. The saved photo paths and the listing row share one transaction; the photo files themselves are written first.
      Parameters:
      actor - the acting seller
      listing - the listing to edit
      state - the edited form
      photos - storage for newly chosen photos
      Returns:
      the saved listing
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if the actor is not an active seller who owns the listing
      IllegalStateException - if the listing is deleted, not Live, Pending Review or Rejected, or has open offers

    • deleteListing

      public void deleteListing(User seller, Listing listing)
      Withdraws one of the seller's own listings (SRS UC-2.4 A1). Open requests are declined, their buyers get a LISTING_REMOVED notice and the listing is hidden — all in one transaction, so a failure part-way through changes nothing. The row is kept so chat, deal and notification history can still resolve the listing by id.
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if seller is not an active Seller who owns the listing
      IllegalStateException - with NOT_CHANGEABLE if the listing is Reserved, Sold, Lent, Given or Taken Down (SRS UC-2.4 A2)

    • markSold

      public void markSold(User actor, Listing listing)
      Marks one of the seller's own live Sale listings as sold (SRS UC-2.5). Open requests are declined and their buyers get an OFFER_UPDATE notice, then the listing is set to SOLD — all in one transaction, so a failure part-way through changes nothing. No deal is created: completing a deal stays the shared deal lifecycle's job.
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if actor is not an active Seller who owns the listing
      IllegalStateException - with NOT_LIVE, NOT_SALE_LISTING or NOT_CHANGEABLE if the listing is not a visible, live Sale listing

    • acceptRequest

      public Deal acceptRequest(User actor, DealRequest request)
      Accepts one of the seller's own PENDING requests; the deal and Reserved/Lent status come from DealLifecycle.accept(DealRequest). Other open requests are captured before the transition because accepting declines them. Each affected buyer gets one OFFER_UPDATE notice: a DEAL ref for the accepted buyer, a REQUEST ref for a buyer whose request was declined. The seller is never notified, and all writes share one transaction.
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if actor is an active Seller who does not own the listing
      IllegalStateException - if the request is not PENDING

    • declineRequest

      public void declineRequest(User actor, DealRequest request)
      Declines one of the seller's own PENDING or COUNTERED requests through DealLifecycle.decline(DealRequest), relisting a pending giveaway claim to Live. The buyer gets one OFFER_UPDATE notice with a REQUEST ref; the seller is never notified, and the status change and notice share one transaction so a failure part-way through changes nothing.
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if actor is not an active Seller who owns the listing
      IllegalStateException - if the request is not PENDING or COUNTERED

    • declineAllForListing

      public void declineAllForListing(User actor, Listing listing)
      Declines every PENDING or COUNTERED request on one of the seller's listings, looping the same DealLifecycle.decline(DealRequest) call used by declineRequest(com.hkust.marketplace.models.User, com.hkust.marketplace.models.DealRequest). Each affected buyer gets one OFFER_UPDATE notice even when they made several requests on the listing; no seller notice is sent and no bulk lifecycle method is added. All writes share one transaction.
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if actor is not an active Seller who owns the listing

    • counterPriceOffer

      public PriceOffer counterPriceOffer(User actor, PriceOffer offer, String rawCounterPrice)
      Proposes one alternative Counter Price on a PENDING Price Offer. The raw amount is turned into a BigDecimal and handed to DealLifecycle.counterOffer(PriceOffer, BigDecimal), which owns the positive-and-two-decimals rule and sets COUNTERED; this service never re-checks those rules. The buyer gets one OFFER_UPDATE notice with a REQUEST ref; the seller is never notified, and the transition and notice share one transaction so a failure changes nothing.
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if actor is not an active Seller who owns the listing
      IllegalStateException - if the request is not PENDING, so it cannot be countered twice
      IllegalArgumentException - if the raw price is malformed or fails the lifecycle rules

    • counterBorrowRequest

      public BorrowRequest counterBorrowRequest(User actor, BorrowRequest request, LocalDateTime start, LocalDateTime end)
      Proposes one alternative Counter Period on a PENDING Borrow Request. The start and end are handed to DealLifecycle.counterBorrow(BorrowRequest, LocalDateTime, LocalDateTime), which owns the not-in-the-past, end-after-start and within-the-listing's-lending-duration rules and sets COUNTERED; this service never re-checks those rules. The buyer gets one OFFER_UPDATE notice with a REQUEST ref; the seller is never notified, and the transition and notice share one transaction.
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if actor is not an active Seller who owns the listing
      IllegalStateException - if the request is not PENDING, so it cannot be countered twice
      IllegalArgumentException - if the period is missing or fails the lifecycle rules

    • pendingRequestsByListing

      public LinkedHashMap<Listing,List<DealRequest>> pendingRequestsByListing(User actor)
      Open requests grouped by listing, newest request group first (the Requests screen). Respondable listings include RESERVED ones, so a pending giveaway claim stays visible after DealLifecycle.submitClaim(com.hkust.marketplace.models.Buyer, com.hkust.marketplace.models.Listing) reserves the listing.
